description: This is the main source file for the backend API of a Tic Tac Toe game. It uses FastAPI to define REST endpoints for managing games, submitting moves, handling scores, and chat interactions, integrating with a MongoDB database, and generating AI trash talk responses.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Model representing a simple message response.

classes.name: GameOut
classes.description: Model representing the serialized state of a game to be returned via API.

classes.name: MoveResponse
classes.description: Model representing the response after a move is made.

classes.name: PlayerScore
classes.description: Model representing a player's score information.

classes.name: PlayerScoreUpdate
classes.description: Model used to update a player's score.

classes.name: ChatRequest
classes.description: Model representing a chat message request.

classes.name: GameCreate
classes.description: Model used for creating a new game.

methods.name: GameOut _serialize_game(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a MongoDB game document into a GameOut model for API responses.

methods.name: GameOut get_game( game_id: str = Path(..., description="Game identifier."), db=Depends(get_db), )
PlayerScore get_player_score( username: str = Path(..., description="Player username."), db=Depends(get_db), )
List[PlayerScore] get_top_scores( limit: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Number of top scores to return."), db=Depends(get_db), )
MoveResponse make_move( payload: MoveRequest, game_id: str = Path(..., description="Game identifier."), db=Depends(get_db), )
PlayerScore set_player_score( payload: PlayerScoreUpdate, username: str = Path(..., description="Player username."), db=Depends(get_db), )
